headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 17, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 17.15%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 9.93%. This results in an average alpha of 7.22%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 50.18%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', still managed a return of 10.04%, which is above the benchmark but reflects a more modest performance. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during a period characterized by macroeconomic uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
